primary_topics: Address at an SBLAA gathering, November 15, 2006 -- CJP as honorary SBLAA member (joining the Tamaraws and Red Lions); San Beda's NCAA basketball championship after 28 years

Three e-values for lawyers and public servants: (1) excellence (best performance, dedication, hard work); (2) ethics/integrity (truth regardless of personal consequences, moral courage); (3) eternity/faith (spiritual rebirth in BLD 1986-1995; trust in the Lord)
Distinguished Bedans encountered through CJP's career: NUSP era (Roco, Saguisag, Trillana, Robles, de la Serna, Brillantes) and SC era (Justices Regalado, Torres, Martinez)
San Beda's partnership with the judiciary for continuing reforms; the San Beda Law motto: Ut in Omnibus Glorificetur Deus
sub_topics: NCAA basketball opener: 'congratulations to San Beda College for winning the National Collegiate Athletic Association basketball crown after 28 years. From what I hear, a San Beda basketball dynasty is in the making. That should not come as a surprise, because Bedans are said to have been dominating all kinds of courts, including our courts of law.'
SBLAA honorary membership: 'Now, I am not only a Tamaraw, I am also a Red Lion!'
Distinguished Bedans in NUSP (late 1950s-early 1960s): Raul Roco, Rene Saguisag, Pablo Trillana, Rudy Robles, Vic de la Serna, Boy Brillantes
Distinguished Bedans in SC (during CJP's 1995-2006 term): Justices Florenz D. Regalado, Justo P. Torres Jr. and Antonio M. Martinez
Excellence: 'excellence was a value that demanded the best performance from all of us all the time. Excellence connotes not merely competence, but also dedication to duty and hard work put together.'

Ethics/integrity: 'We must also strive to possess uncompromising personal integrity. Integrity refers not only to honesty, but also to truth. A person of integrity acts in accordance with what is true and honest regardless of personal consequences. Integrity requires the moral courage to stand for one's convictions against all odds.'

Eternity/faith: 'the third e-value is faith in eternity as our final destiny'; Leni and CJP's spiritual rebirth from 1986 to 1995 in Bukas Loob sa Diyos; 'I have learned to trust the Lord and to depend on Him for all my needs, aspirations and wants'
Good roots, good fruits: 'for the fruit to be of good quality, the plant must be rooted well. Good roots yield good fruits.'
San Beda partnership: 'San Beda College of Law shares our vision for the improvement of legal and ethical standards'
St. Paul excerpts: 'Stand by what you have learned and what has been entrusted to you... Run the great race of faith; take hold of eternal life. Let us never tire of doing good...'
San Beda motto: 'Ut in Omnibus Glorificetur Deus -- That in All Things, God May Be Glorified!'

stances.claim: The three e-values (excellence, ethics, eternity) form a complete life framework: excellence without ethics becomes mere competitiveness; ethics without eternity becomes mere rule-following; eternity without excellence becomes passive resignation. The three must reinforce each other.
stances.rhetorical_move: three-e-completeness argument: the three values as mutually necessary components of a life worth living

stances.claim: Integrity is categorically distinct from honesty: 'integrity refers not only to honesty, but also to truth. A person of integrity acts in accordance with what is true and honest regardless of personal consequences. Integrity requires the moral courage to stand for one's convictions against all odds.' Honesty is passive (not lying); integrity is active (defending the truth at personal cost).
stances.rhetorical_move: honesty-vs-integrity distinction (Bedan version): the same analytical move as in Diokno (SA132) but applied here to the professional standards of Bedan lawyers
stances.confidence: asserted as the governing professional standard

one_paragraph_summary: Delivered November 15, 2006 at an SBLAA gathering -- CJP as honorary member ('Now, I am not only a Tamaraw, I am also a Red Lion!') -- this address opens by congratulating San Beda on its NCAA basketball championship after 28 years: 'Bedans are said to have been dominating all kinds of courts, including our courts of law.' He names distinguished Bedans from his NUSP years (Raul Roco, Rene Saguisag, Pablo Trillana, Rudy Robles, Vic de la Serna, Boy Brillantes) and from his SC tenure (Justices Florenz Regalado, Justo Torres and Antonio Martinez). He presents three e-values: (1) Excellence -- 'a value that demanded the best performance from all of us all the time... not merely competence, but also dedication to duty and hard work'; (2) Ethics/Integrity -- 'Integrity refers not only to honesty, but also to truth. A person of integrity acts in accordance with what is true and honest regardless of personal consequences. Integrity requires the moral courage to stand for one's convictions against all odds'; (3) Eternity/Faith -- 'My wife Leni and I underwent a spiritual rebirth from 1986 to 1995 after we joined the Bukas Loob sa Diyos... I have learned to trust the Lord and to depend on Him for all my needs, aspirations and wants.' He notes that 'for the fruit to be of good quality, the plant must be rooted well. Good roots yield good fruits.' He closes with St. Paul excerpts and the San Beda motto: 'Ut in Omnibus Glorificetur Deus -- That in All Things, God May Be Glorified!'
